title: Attaclone-dedup: Detecting and managing duplicate file attachments in Zotero
description: Attaclone-dedup is a plugin for the Zotero reference manager that finds duplicate file attachments within a bibliographic item by comparing content hashes rather than filenames. Byte-identical copies that carry no additional information are resolved automatically, while ambiguous cases are presented in a review dialogue so that the user decides what to keep. Annotations can optionally be merged when copies of a document carry different highlights or notes. It is aimed at researchers whose libraries have accumulated repeated PDF attachments through synchronisation or repeated downloads.
